actionConfiguration.body: SELECT r.*, a.ani002_nome, ac.acomo001_desc AS acomo001_nome FROM "{{JSutils.currentSchema()}}".hotreserva001 r INNER JOIN "{{JSutils.currentSchema()}}".hotani002 a ON a.ani002_id = r.reserva001_ani002_id LEFT JOIN "{{JSutils.currentSchema()}}".hotacomo001 ac ON ac.acomo001_id = r.reserva001_acomo001_id WHERE r.reserva001_deleted <> true ORDER BY r.reserva001_checkin DESC LIMIT {{TableReservas.pageSize}} OFFSET {{(TableReservas.pageNo - 1) * TableReservas.pageSize}};
